body.prose:
Any whole can be taken away as a store of its own: what it holds, through every reference that holds, with every version they had and the commits that touched them. Its types come with it always, since what it holds is read through them, and what it points at comes by choice, each still with its id and versions, so the day it meets the store they came from again, they plug back in. Relying on other foundations is no fault; it is how anything is built.

*The author's, 2026-11-04: you rely upon other foundations to build yours, that's completely fine; they still have their id, their version, and would plug back in. How the commits that touched a whole are found is [above](ref:01M6M9PESED8DSZJA9N8NQRRKX).*
body.title: Taking a whole away
